In Iran, an exhibition displaying the wreckage of various intercepted Israeli and U.S. aerial vehicles has been established at one of the country’s underground bases.
Among the displayed debris are fragments of U.S. MQ-9A Reaper and MQ-1C Gray Eagle unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), as well as an Israeli Hermes 900 UAV.
The exhibition also shows the ACES II ejection seat system and canopy from a U.S. Air Force F-15E Strike Eagle assigned to the 494th Fighter Squadron, part of the 48th Fighter Wing based at RAF Lakenheath, United Kingdom.
The F-15E was intercepted over southern Iran in April of this year.
